versions.changelog:
Initial release of video-transcript-extractor-guaikei.

- Convert video or audio (local files or URLs) into clean, reusable transcripts with semantic understanding and redundancy removal.
- Supports custom prompts to generate summaries, rewrite content in various styles, extract highlights, split into scenes, or translate.
- Cloud-based processing; handles both short and long videos from platforms like Douyin, Xiaohongshu, or local files.
- Outputs structured content suitable for meeting minutes, interviews, course breakdowns, and content repurposing.
- Emphasizes privacy: temporary cloud processing, no data retention or external sharing.
- Token-based authentication required before use.
